chapter: Bolden and the road to New Orleans
title: First meeting Bolden at the New Orleans music store
summary: While trying his new trombone, Ory was heard by Bolden, who invited him to join, but his sister refused.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: When did you first see Bolden, do you remember?
When I bought my first good horn.
How old were you then? Fourteen. Your first slide trombone.

How old were you? Do you remember? Fourteen. Well, uh... You said. I was, uh... You see, I was ten, played a job at the old horn. I guess it picked me. I was about eleven years old. It was a year later, I bought the horn, you know? Where, where did you meet Bolden? I was, uh... I just bought my horn from the Whirline Music Store. Where there, my sister was living in New Orleans, and I stopped with her, you know. Is that the first time you went to New Orleans? That's my first time, yeah. And I was running over the horn, running over. Blowing the sound, you see. I liked it. I blew it. I was running over the horn, or they tried it in the music store, and Bolden happened to pass by, and he heard the trombone out, and he knocked on the door.
You just walked him down the street, you remember?

Yeah. Uh, Jackson and... and Roberson Street. Uh-huh. I was on Jackson, and he heard the horn, and he stopped, and he rapped on the door. I came to the serial man, he said, are you going to trombone? I said, yeah. Yes, sir. He said, well, you know who I am? I said, I don't really. He said, I'm the king. I said, king who? He said, Bolden. I said, no, hey, Mr. Bolden. He said, uh, you live here? I said, no, not exactly. My sister lives here. I live out in the country. He said, but I'd like to have you to work with me. I tell you sound very good. Is that so? He must have been. I said, I've been. Yes, that's so. He must have stayed out there and had me play. Because the first day you were trying out this new instrument. Yes. And, uh, so I said, wait a minute. I was so tickled, you know. I thought, oh, man, I'm going to play with King Bolden. I'm like my sister, I said, come here. I said, explain to my sister what you want. She said, oh, no, he had to go back home. He can't leave home that he's 21 years old.
